headline: Russian drone strikes hit Kyiv, killing at least two
caption:
🇪🇸 Ataques rusos con drones golpearon Kyiv el 23 de septiembre, alcanzando infraestructura ferroviaria, almacenes y estaciones de combustible. Reuters y AP reportaron al menos dos muertos en la capital y múltiples heridos.

🇺🇸 Russian drone strikes hit Kyiv on September 23, striking railway infrastructure, warehouses and fuel stations. Reuters and AP reported at least two people killed in the capital and multiple others wounded.

Sources: Reuters / AP — Sept. 23, 2026.

verification_note: Reuters reported on Sept. 23, 2026 that Russian drone strikes hit Kyiv railway infrastructure, warehouses and fuel stations and killed at least two people in the capital. An accessible AP syndicated report independently described the Sept. 23 Kyiv drone attacks, reporting two killed and 23 wounded. The caption limits claims to details supported by those reports.
